summary:
Revised Milestone 2 implementation plan strictly aligned with all three requested corrections:
1. AUDIT BEFORE FIXING: Mandatory live-repository code audit and evidence reporting with exact lines before any fix; smallest safe changes only.
2. RESOLVE LEGACY-SYNC TRIGGERS: Legacy localStorage sync is strictly restricted to explicit Save Blueprint and Export Blueprint/BOM actions. 4K image exports and AI 3D blueprint generation are audited and prohibited from triggering storage writes. No writes on load or tab change. Adding any other sync trigger requires explicit user approval.
3. THREE DISTINCT PHASES: Phased strictly into Phase 1 (Audit & Data Integrity Fixes with Regression Tests), Phase 2 (Interactive Canvas, Form Validation, Track Expansion, & Explicit Sync), and Phase 3 (Verification, Regression Testing, and Final Sign-Off Report with zero pushes or deployments).
